name: Midnight Paste Relay
description: A hacker collective's paste relay has gone quiet after a midnight purge. Find the reachable service on the lab network and recover its protected dispatch. Scan 172.20.0.0/24; challenge hosts are in 172.20.0.141-199.

tasks.name: Recover the Dispatch
tasks.description: Search the lab network for the collective's reachable service and recover the protected dispatch. Scan 172.20.0.0/24; challenge hosts are in 172.20.0.141-199.
hints: Check whether the reachable service offers any content before you authenticate.
Inspect the public material for an account note, then try those credentials with the same service.
Sign in with the recovered account and read the restricted dispatch.
